definition: A training approach where a model learns to map raw inputs directly to desired outputs, without relying on separately engineered intermediate processing stages.
details: End-to-end learning contrasts with traditional pipelines composed of multiple hand-designed, independently optimized stages, and has become dominant in deep learning as models have proven capable of learning entire complex mappings directly from data.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. Think of it this way: A training approach where a model learns to map raw inputs directly to desired outputs, without relying on separately engineered intermediate processing stages. And here is the clever part: End-to-end learning contrasts with traditional pipelines composed of multiple hand-designed, independently optimized stages, and has become dominant in deep learning as models have proven capable of learning entire complex mappings directly from data. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. And that is End-to-End Learning — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
